name: ShardedCounter
purpose: Hot-key-safe monotonic per-key counter distributed across N fixed shards; value() sums across shards.

invariants.rule: Counter MUST NEVER decrement (delta MUST be > 0).
Read-after-write in the same session reflects at least the preceding increment (session causality, not global consistency).
value(key) is the SUM of all shard values -- never a single shard.
Shard count is fixed at construction; changing it requires a migration primitive.
Concurrent increments on the same key hit DIFFERENT shards (hashed modulo shard_count on thread/async-task id).

extension_contract: Adopters pick shard_count at construction. Hash for routing is sealed. Redis INCRBY-per-shard and Postgres row-per-shard adapters fit the same Protocol.
why_essential: Without sharding, every concurrent writer on a hot key serializes through one row and the counter becomes a throughput cliff under load.
alternatives_considered: Single-row counter: serializes writers on the hot key.
Event-sourced counter: correct but expensive to read.
